last.verdict: Record quarter and a big guide higher; shares edged up as spending rises.

reasons.label: Guidance far above forecasts
reasons.text: Next-quarter revenue guided to $61.5 billion, versus roughly $56.8 billion analysts expected.

reasons.label: Another big beat
reasons.text: Revenue hit $54.2 billion and profit $33.42 a share, versus about $51.1 billion and $31.61 expected.

reasons.label: Tight supply, locked-in demand
reasons.text: Customer deals cover over 35% of revenue through 2030; supply seen much tighter in 2027.

story: Revenue has climbed from $23.9 billion to $41.5 billion to $54.2 billion in three quarters, with each guide above forecasts. Reactions varied: down about 6% in March after a capex jump, up sharply in June, and only a modest gain now.
